PDQL: filter(host.fqdn and not networkdevicehost) | select(Host.fqdn, COUNTUNIQUE(Host.@id) as ID_Cnt, COMPACTUNIQUE(@Host)) | filter(ID_Cnt > 1)
filter(host.hostname and not host.fqdn and not networkdevicehost) | select(Host.hostname, COUNTUNIQUE(Host.@id) as ID_Cnt, COMPACTUNIQUE(@Host)) | filter(ID_Cnt > 1)

comment: Много IP примапилось к одному узлу из HostDiscovery
PDQL: filter((Host.OsCandidates.Detection LIKE 'HD%' or Host.OsVersion LIKE '%-%') and not networkdevicehost)| select(@Host, Host.hostname as HOSTN, host.fqdn as HOSTF, Host.Endpoints<IpEndpoint>.Address as IP_addr) | filter(not IP_addr in 127.0.0.0/8 and not IP_addr in ::1/128) | select( @Host, COUNTUNIQUE(IP_addr) as IP_Cnt, COMPACTUNIQUE(IP_addr)) | filter(IP_Cnt > 5)
